YsQy-Book — A lightweight novel reading plugin for IntelliJ IDEA.
Supports chapter-based reading, page jumping, auto page turning, and reading progress persistence.
Enjoy your favorite books directly within your IDE with seamless reading experience.

🆕 Version 1.1.1 - Major Update:
✨ Reading Progress Persistence: Automatically saves and restores your reading progress
🔄 Multi-Project Support: Each project maintains independent reading state
🚀 Auto-Load on Startup: Automatically loads your last novel when opening IDEA
📖 Smart Chapter Navigation: Chapter list automatically positions to current reading location
⚡ Real-time Progress Saving: Progress is saved automatically with every page turn

Usage:
1. IDEA Settings > Tools > YsQy Book: Set the novel path and auto page turn interval.
2. Bottom-left corner of IDEA: Read novels directly in the status bar.
3. YsQy-Book sidebar: Navigate chapters and menus.
4. Seamless Experience: Your reading progress is automatically saved and restored!

YsQy-Book — 一款轻量级 IntelliJ IDEA 小说阅读插件，支持章节阅读、页码跳转、自动翻页与阅读进度持久化功能，让你在编码间隙轻松阅读。

🆕 版本 1.1.1 - 重大更新：
✨ 阅读进度持久化：自动保存和恢复阅读进度
🔄 多项目支持：每个项目独立维护阅读状态
🚀 启动自动加载：打开IDEA时自动加载上次的小说
📖 智能章节导航：章节列表自动定位到当前阅读位置
⚡ 实时进度保存：每次翻页自动保存进度

使用说明：
1. IDEA 设置 > 工具 > YsQy Book：设置小说路径和自动翻页秒数。
2. IDEA 左下角：直接在状态栏阅读小说。
3. YsQy-Book 侧边栏：浏览章节和菜单。
4. 无缝体验：阅读进度自动保存和恢复！
